Dear EFEE team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Intern position starting 2 November 2026. My background combines digital marketing, content creation and web management. I run baverok.com, build WordPress sites in Elementor, and create SEO content and structured data for clients. I use Canva for visuals, work with Google Analytics and Search Console to monitor performance, and use AI tools daily for research, content and audits. I also have front-end experience with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, which helps me keep websites practical and user-friendly. I would welcome the chance to support EFEE's LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube and website content, and to learn from your team in Brussels. I will provide the required confirmation of eligibility for an internship funding mechanism. My CV and motivation letter are attached, and my portfolio is at baverok.com. Thank you for your consideration.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear EFEE team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Intern position starting 2 November 2026. I am a digital marketer with a technical background, working where SEO, content and web meet. I would welcome the chance to bring this mix to EFEE and support your social media, website and digital communications in Brussels.

In my freelance work, I designed, built and run baverok.com and built and optimized mirook.com, including structured data, accessible markup and iterative SEO/GEO audits. At Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, publish and update pages, blog posts and media in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math), and maintain Shopify stores. At Knowledge Experts, I supported SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, designed client websites with social media integration, and reported on performance with Google Search Console and Google Analytics. My earlier front-end role at ViviDoctor gave me hands-on HTML, CSS and JavaScript experience.

I use Canva for visuals and AI tools daily for research, content and audits. I enjoy the creative side of web and content work, and I am keen to learn more about video production and European policy processes. I am fluent in English, native in Turkish, and improving my Dutch. I am used to managing multiple projects, keeping content current and reporting on performance.

I am available from 2 November 2026 for a full-time, hybrid internship, with at least three office days per week, and I can travel occasionally across Europe. I will provide the required confirmation of eligibility for an internship funding mechanism. My portfolio is at baverok.com. Thank you for considering my application. I would be glad to discuss how my web, content and analytics skills can support EFEE's communications.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
